releaseNotes: SOLVE OOS upgraded to the general auto-solver: Case 2 (Not Started to Active) and Case-4 FS/SF now auto-repaired with canonical retypes (lag 0) and BFS frontier bridging.
General solver-caused dangling repair: new dangling starts and finishes are rebuilt automatically with context-ranked edges (SameCode / SameWbsParent / ProjectWide).
SOLVE OOS window reworked: compact summary cards, case filters and Case-4 bridge detail replace the findings text wall.
Convergence guarantee: SOLVED is declared only when the final output re-analyzes to zero actionable OOS, loop-free.
No changes to the updater, installer, registration, or the P6 Classic / P6 Soft visual languages.
